summary: Architectural blueprint for fixing and polishing the mobile UI of Chess Hashira Training as a brutalist mobile game console. Establishes a strict 100dvh non-scrollable viewport grid, a compact 44px top navigation strip with 3 dropdown overlays, a shallow 68px Sensei Gensei panel with no duplicate controls, a dynamic-fitting board stage that calculates available dimensions via ResizeObserver to eliminate clipping, and a single 48px bottom bar with truncated lesson metadata and action buttons, while keeping the desktop 3-column studio completely intact.
